app.name: Somiti
app.tagline: Savings and loan management for cooperative somitis

home.status: Foundation release: the ledger core is in place. Sign-in, vouchers and the trial balance screen come next.
home.sampleHeading: How numbers and dates will look

playground.title: Type an amount
playground.hint: English or Bangla digits, with or without ৳.
playground.invalid: Enter a positive amount with up to two decimal places.
playground.paisa: Stored as {count} paisa, never as a floating-point number.

balance.title: Double-entry, always balanced
balance.lead: Move the slider: every deposit debits cash and credits member savings by the same amount.

features.ledgerBody: Posted entries are never edited. Corrections are reversals, so the audit trail stays complete.
features.tenantBody: Row-level security in the database keeps every somiti's data separate.
features.bilingualBody: Lakh and crore grouping, Bangla digits and Dhaka dates throughout.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.m1: Ledger core, tenant isolation, bilingual interface

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some details are missing or invalid.
errors.UNBALANCED: Debits and credits must be equal.
errors.APPEND_ONLY: Posted entries cannot be changed. Post a reversal instead.
errors.DAY_CLOSED: That day is already closed. Post on today's date instead.
errors.NO_OPEN_PERIOD: There is no open fiscal year for that date.
errors.AFTER_BUSINESS_DATE: The date cannot be after today's business date.
errors.WRONG_BUSINESS_DATE: Only the current business day can be closed.
errors.UNKNOWN_TENANT: This somiti could not be found.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_POSTABLE: One of the accounts cannot take entries.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The entry could not be found.
errors.ALREADY_REVERSED: This entry has already been reversed.
errors.CANNOT_REVERSE_REVERSAL: A reversal cannot be reversed. Post a new entry instead.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request was already sent with different details.

auth.title: Sign in to your somiti
auth.subtitle: We'll text a one-time code to your phone. No password to remember.
auth.slugHint: Ask your somiti office if you don't know it.
auth.devHint: Development mode: no SMS is sent. The code is printed in the terminal running pnpm dev.
auth.artTitle: Your somiti's books, in your pocket

artPoints.one: Savings, loans and shares in one place
artPoints.two: Every taka balanced, every entry audited

errors.missing: Enter your somiti code and mobile number.
errors.invalid_phone: That doesn't look like a Bangladeshi mobile number. Use 11 digits starting with 01.
errors.unknown_somiti: We couldn't find a somiti with that code.
errors.too_many: Too many codes requested. Please wait an hour and try again.
errors.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.locked: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

tiles.membersBody: Register members and their savings accounts.
tiles.trialBalanceBody: See every account balanced, as of any day.
